variations.name: Approval
variations.why: the agent asks before it does something with side effects; you approve or reject

variations.name: Plan and tasks
variations.why: the agent's plan, to-do list or delegated tasks, with progress

variations.name: Working status
variations.why: shows the agent is thinking or working right now: shimmer, thinking bar, dots

variations.name: Usage and cost
variations.why: tokens, context window and money the run used

variations.name: Inline citations
variations.why: numbered references inside the answer, with a preview on hover

variations.name: Live preview
variations.why: a running web page, JSX or sandbox the agent built, shown in place

variations.name: Checkpoints
variations.why: points in the conversation you can roll back to

variations.name: Workflow graph
variations.why: the agent's work as nodes and edges on a canvas

variations.name: Notices and errors
variations.why: a system note, refusal, quota or failure shown in the thread with a way forward

variations.name: Generated image
variations.why: an image the model made or returned, with loading and full view

variations.name: Asks you a question
variations.why: the agent pauses to ask: options, a short form or a few questions

variations.name: Structured answer
variations.why: an answer drawn as a card: a comparison, a score, a spec sheet

variations.name: Diagram and maths
variations.why: Mermaid diagrams and rendered maths inside an answer

variations.name: Agent settings
variations.why: model, prompt, tools, MCP servers and keys the agent runs with

variations.name: Agent card and handoff
variations.why: who the agent is, and work passing between agents or subagents

variations.name: Transcript and read aloud
variations.why: speech turned to text, or an answer read back with words lit

variations.name: Memory
variations.why: what the agent remembers about you, removable

variations.name: Computer use
variations.why: the screen the agent is driving, with its cursor

variations.name: Markdown answer
variations.why: the reply rendered as headings, lists, links and code

variations.name: Actions and feedback
variations.why: copy, rate, regenerate and thumbs-down-with-a-reason under a reply

variations.name: Branches and edit
variations.why: edit a turn, flip between regenerated versions, fork to another model

variations.name: Queued prompts
variations.why: messages typed while the agent is busy wait in a cancelable queue

variations.name: Voice input
variations.why: speak instead of type: mic button, mic and voice pickers

variations.name: Mentions and commands
variations.why: @ mentions and / commands that pop a picker and render as chips

variations.name: Quote and reply
variations.why: select text in an answer and quote it into the composer

variations.name: Run results
variations.why: what running code produced: output, stack trace, test results

variations.name: API schema
variations.why: an endpoint's parameters and body laid out to read

variations.name: Floating widget
variations.why: a chat bubble in the corner that opens into a panel (support, help desk)

variations.name: Side panel
variations.why: a copilot docked beside the app's own page

variations.name: Conversation list
variations.why: past conversations to switch between, with search

variations.name: Find in thread
variations.why: a map or search of one long conversation

variations.name: Jump to latest
variations.why: streaming keeps your place; a button takes you back down
